What Sets JB'S Apart?

JB'S Pro Painters LLC is owner-operated by Jonathan Bernal. When you call, you talk to the person who looks at your job, gives you the estimate and stands behind the finish. We paint homes and businesses across the East Valley, inside and out.

Interior walls and ceilings, stucco exteriors, kitchen cabinets, doors and wood stain, and commercial repaints for restaurants, warehouses and shops. Quality, precision and perfection on every wall. See our painting services or request a free estimate.

Painting Services Across the East Valley

JB'S Pro Painters LLC serves Gilbert, Mesa, Chandler, Tempe, Scottsdale, Queen Creek and nearby, for homeowners and businesses alike.

  • Careful painters: we pay attention to detail, from prep to the last coat, and we are licensed and insured.
  • Complete painting: residential, commercial, interior, exterior, cabinets, doors and wood stain.
  • Free estimates: tell us about the job and you get a free estimate before any work starts.
